batting.dismissal: c KT Maphaka b Yudhvir Singh

batting.dismissal: c YBK Jaiswal b Akash Madhwal

batting.dismissal: c TU Deshpande b Akash Madhwal

batting.name: SV Samson
batting.dismissal: c D Brevis b R Ashwin

balls.text: in the blockhole to finish a superb exhibition of death bowling from RR, dug out to deep midwicket for a single, but a fumble from Samson collecting a sloppy throw allows the extra run

sharp catch at short fine leg! Deshpande is stunned at what he's done. Dhoni got down on one knee to paddle sweep a full toss and he hit it really hard, but flat and straight at Deshpande, who reached up and caught it over his head, tumbling backwards with the momentum of the ball

clears his front foot and swings the ball through midwicket, the fielder had to cover a lot of distance from square leg to get to the ball but Dhoni did not want to take the second run that was on offer
low full toss on middle stump, Kamboj clears his front foot and hits it hard down the ground, Parag can't save it running to his left from long-on, boundary after 15 deliveries
in the blockhole outside off, Kamboj swings and misses
low full toss, Dube smashes it, flat and hard but not high enough, Jaiswal is on the long-on boundary and he catches it reverse-cup as he tumbles backwards, RR have pulled CSK back big time
another exceptional over at the death, a low full toss outside off that Dube mis-times, lofting it in the air but only as far as just outside the circle at mid-on
Dhoni tries to cut a short of a length ball and only manages to hit it in the air and just short of point
full to Dube, nearly in the blockhole, he plays a lofted drive towards long off
slower ball, short of a length outside off, Dhoni sways back and hits it through point
played to wide long on for a single, dug out an attempted yorker from around the wicket
a low full toss on leg stump, Dhoni stays in his crease and swings it away towards deep square leg, reaches the fielder on the first bounce, he couldn't get under it to get elevation on the shot
backs away towards leg to create room but can't beat cover, top over from Madhwal
driven to long on for a single, hit it from the blockhole
Dube biffs at the full toss, clearing his front foot and looking to slam it down the ground, he mis-times it towards long off
full and on the pads, it's there for the taking with short fine in the circle but Dhoni misses the glance and gets hit on his back boot
in the blockhole on middle stump, Dube clips it off his toes towards fine leg
driven firmly into the covers
punched down the ground for a single
bowled extremely wide outside off, Dube lets it go
tossed up with width to the left-hander, Dube makes a movement towards the off and frees his arms, lofting the wide ball high and over the straight boundary
another wide one outside off, Dhoni reaches for it again and hits it to wide long off
mistimes the ball into the off side, Hasaranga is keeping it wide outside off, Dhoni would have got another wide had he let this go

lets it go this time close to the wide line, the umpire says it is a legal ball and Dhoni will challenge it. That looked inside the wide line in real time but replays confirm that Dhoni is right, gets the decision overturned in his favour
Dhoni reaches for one wide outside off and hits it to cover
Dube tries to smash it off the back foot but mis-times the ball towards mid off
cut through point, there was lots of width outside off to work with
pings off the sightscreen and back into play! Parag tossed it up with a round arm action, Dhoni got under the full ball and smashed it back over the bowler's head
played to deep midwicket
strays down leg side once again, Dube can't connect with the sweep across the line
width outside off, short length as well, Dhoni slaps it off the back foot flat towards long off
Dhoni clears his front foot and hits the ball back to the bowler
played off the pads gently through the leg side
strays down leg from around the wicket, Dube lets it go
similar ball outside off stump, but this time Dube reaches for it and hits it wide of the fielder at cover for a single
fired it flat and wide outside off from over the wicket across the left-hander, Dube reaches for it and hits it to point
that's in the first tier beyond the midwicket boundary! Hasaranga gave it some air, Dube stepped out of his crease and gave it even more air, using those long arms of his to generate so much power
goes right back and hits the ball down to long on for a single
steps out and chips it in the air but short of the bowler
tossed up on off and middle, Dhoni meets it on the front foot and plays back to the bowler
looks for the blockhole around off stump, Dube stays in his crease and plays to cover
full ball outside off, Dhoni leans forward and plays the square drive through point
bowled him! Brevis' bright and entertaining innings ends with a rather ungainly hoick across the line to a full ball and an inside edge on to the stumps ... the crowd erupts because it's Dhoni time.
good length on off stump, Dube leans into the front foot drive to long off
looks for the yorker and bowls a low full toss on the pads that Dube clips to deep square leg where a tag-team effort saves the boundary
short of a length outside off, Brevis clears his front foot and flat-bats the ball hard to wide long off
gives Hasaranga full view of the stumps by moving outside leg and then drives the ball firmly towards wide long off
fired in quick outside off, he lets this one go
backs away again outside leg and slaps the ball towards cover, Brevis does not look as assured against Hasaranga
spins one across the left-hander from over the wicket, Dube stays back and drives to long off
backs away towards leg and cuts the ball from in front of his stumps through the off side

tossed up on off and middle with spin into the right-hander, Brevis swings towards midwicket but gets a thick inside edge towards deep square where Jaiswal runs a fair distance and dives to his left to save the boundary
another one in the blockhole to Brevis, dug out past the bowler for a single
in the blockhole, haven't seen much of that tonight, Dube digs it out on the off side
driven from the crease towards point where a fumble allows the single
short of a length and straight, Dube nudges off his hips towards midwicket
short ball outside off this time and Dube stands tall and uses his bat as a ramp to loft the ball over backward point
full and fast down leg side, Dube misses with the flick and Samson misses with the dive
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Brevis tries to drive on the off side but gets an inside edge behind square leg
he's got away with that, it was short and wide outside off, Dube hit it hard off the back foot but could not pierce the gap at cover
short ball and this time Dube is ready and waiting, pulls it into the gap on the deep midwicket boundary, CSK rattling along at superb pace
full toss outside off, Brevis tries to hit it a bit too hard and takes one hand off the bat as he sends the ball along the ground through midwicket
gets squared up a touch by a good length ball that straightens off the pitch and the outside edge goes towards short third
full ball, too full, Brevis gets under it and uses those gifted wrists of his to drive the ball flat and far over the long-on boundary for another six
Dube stays in his crease and plays a punchy-drive on the up to wide mid off
looped up very wide outside off from around the wicket, Brevis makes a big effort to move outside off and reach it, drives to deep cover for a single, might have got a wide had he let it go
another long hop and Brevis blasts it flat over the midwicket boundary, pulled with tremendous power
a long hop outside off, this time Brevis puts it away, slapping it off the back foot into the gap on the cover boundary
swept behind square for a single
played from the crease to point
strays down leg side to the left-hander from around the wicket, Dube lets it go
fired wide outside off from around the wicket, Brevis reaches for it and slaps the ball flat and in the air towards long off, reaches the fielder on the first bounce
another slower one on leg and middle, Brevis waits for it and pushes through midwicket
slower ball and on a fuller length, but down leg side again
short ball but too far down leg for Brevis to make contact with the pull
high and far over deep midwicket! A bit of the Guptill no-look flick in that shot. It was full and on leg stump and he made great contact
a fourth consecutive short one at Dube but this time there's width and he flays his hands at the ball and cuts hard to deep point where the fielder makes a diving save
another short one at Dube, he tries to ramp it over the keeper but does not make contact
slower ball on a wicket to wicket line, Brevis adjusts to the change in pace and punches the ball hard into the pitch, Mphaka can't collect as the ball bounces over his head and concedes the single
short of a length angling across the right-hander from over the wicket, Brevis stays back and cuts hard but misses
short of a length again, pushing Dube back in his crease, he defends on the off side
bangs it in short on a wicket to wicket line, Dube sways out of the way as the ball flies past his head
another one bites the dust. A tame ball, a tame shot, a tame dismissal. Full ball on the pads, the bat turns in Jadeja's hands as he flicks, and he hits it straight to midwicket
driven to long on for a single
dug in short, this time Brevis mis-times the pull shot, clears the infield though
shot! He can play all right. Stays back to a short of a length ball and punches with a slightly open face to place the ball into the gap on the backward point boundary
leans forward and defends into the covers
worked off his pads to short fine leg
spins back into the right-hander, Brevis goes back and cuts from in front of his stumps to point
lofted straight to the fielder at deep midwicket, Ashwin's cameo is over. He stepped out of his crease and swung across the line, picking out Hetmyer at deep midwicket
leans forward and clips the full ball off his toes through square leg
nudged off the front foot behind square leg
short of a length and straight, Jadeja defends on the off side

caught in the deep this time! That's the second superb catch for Mphaka this evening. It was a full delivery, in the slot, and Mhatre wanted to hit it for six down the ground. He made contact with the bottom of his bat though and didn't time it well. Mphaka came running in off the boundary and dived forward to take a low catch
three in a row! This time on the off side via an upper cut behind point. Deshpande is bowling short and wide friendly deliveries
in front of square this time, too short again and Mhatre plays a powerful pull to loft the ball over the in-field
too short, Mhatre opens up his stance to swing the ball with the angle into him to the backward square leg boundary
Deshpande is a bit excited after Ashwin misses the flick and gets hit on the pad, the ball goes on the off side and they run a leg bye, that would have missed leg stump
short of a length angling across the right-hander, Mhatre gets squared up a touch and then opens the face to steer the ball towards deep point, this outfield is quick
slogged in the air and just over the head of the fielder at mid-on and once the ball falls safe it races away to the boundary
driven hard on the up down the ground but can't beat mid-off
short of a length with width to free his arms, Mhatre clears his front foot towards the leg side and slashes over short third
punched towards mid on off the front foot
played behind point for a single, used the angle across him from over the wicket and opened the face of the bat
stays leg side of the length ball outside off and uses the width to free his arms and slap the ball to the cover boundary
cashes in on it big time. Opens up his stance and pulls the short of a length ball over the wide long-on boundary for his first six
strays down leg again, Ashwin nudges off his pads for a single to short fine leg ... and whoops, the siren for no-ball goes off. Mhatre will have a free-hit next ball
slammed over the square leg boundary! Too full and slanting towards the pads, Ashwin uses his long reach to get under the ball and give it a proper smack
Ashwin tries to swing the short delivery through the leg side and gets a bit of bat on it to send the ball wide of the keeper to the fine leg boundary
moves a bit towards the leg side and punches a length delivery through point
good length on a wicket to wicket line, Ashwin works the ball off his pads in front of square leg
tries to hit it a bit too hard through the leg side and gets an inside edge on to his pad
on the up this time and over the in-field! Mhatre plants his front foot forward and lofts through the line to dispatch a length ball to the straight boundary
tries to biff it down the ground but is cramped for room and can't beat mid-off
too short and Mhatre scores the third boundary of the innings with a well-timed pull shot
good length on off and middle, defended towards cover
short of a length on off and middle, defended on the off side

two in the over for Yudhvir! And superbly caught on the edge up the circle by Mphaka pedalling backwards at mid-on. Hard length on a wicket to wicket line, Patel tried to slog down the ground, the bat turned in his hand as he made contact, Mphaka moved back quickly to take that above his head
short and wide outside off, Patel slashes and gets a thick edge along the ground to short third, where Suryavanshi makes a sharp save

pops a simple catch to mid-off! Conway came rushing down the pitch and was in an awkward position to play the short of a length ball at his body, he tried to chip it on the up and managed to only get it as far as Parag inside the circle
played off the front foot towards cover
short of a length with some lift outside off, Conway goes back and adjusts well to the bounce, cutting fine enough to beat the deep third
short and wide outside off at a gentle pace, Mhatre goes back and cuts towards deep third, he should have put that away for more
tries to slash outside off again and misses again
angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Conway has a swish at that short of a length ball and misses
short of a length on leg and middle, played from the crease towards midwicket
too full and straight, Conway presses forward and drives back past the bowler, perfect timing for the first boundary of the game
short of a length, pitching outside leg and ending up on the left-hander's hips, Conway tucks it behind square

fullish length with some movement away from the right-hander outside off stump, Mhatre drives at it from the crease and gets an outside edge that falls short of the keeper, Samson dives to his right and gets glove on it to take the pace off the ball

all over, good night! Jurel ends the game by swinging the length ball over the square leg boundary, he celebrates with a shake of his fists as he finally seals a chase, something that has haunted this team all season.
down the track, frees his arms and hoists the ball high and far over the square leg boundary, RR racing towards the finish line and away from the bottom of the table
fired down leg side and Hetmyer glances the ball off his pads past Dhoni to the fine leg boundary
driven to long on for a single
tees off, and that's in the stands! Clears his front foot towards the leg side and frees his arms, lofting the full ball angling into him over deep midwicket, surely that's the game now for RR?
wicket to wicket line to the right hander, played from the crease to midwicket
strides forward and drives the ball along the ground to wide long off
stays back and works the ball through midwicket for a single
tries to punch off the back foot but gets beaten close to off stump
fired down leg side from over the wicket, Hetmyer misses the glance and Dhoni was standing outside off stump so was too far away to try and prevent the five wides

another twist in the chase as Noor bowls a ripper! He slants the ball across the right-hander from over the wicket and then spins it back in after pitching outside off stump, Parag pushes out at it and gets an inside edge back on to his stumps
bowled wide down leg side, Jurel and Dhoni miss it but short fine leg cleans up
nudged off the pads through midwicket for a single
lovely from Jurel, this ball is slower but the line is on leg stump, he leans across, gets down on one knee, and beats the fielder at short fine leg with the sweep
fired in flat and across the right-hander from over the wicket, Jurel pulls along the ground to deep midwicket
driven to long off for a single to end the over
huge couple of balls for RR as Jadeja strays on to the leg side this time, Jurel waits and paddles the ball behind square to the long leg boundary
such a long, long hop from Jadeja, Jurel rocks back and helps himself to a big serving of six, slamming the pull into the stands at midwicket
fired in quick from around the wicket, nudged back towards Jadeja's right and he scampers across to prevent the single
played off the back foot towards the bowler
driven to wide long off for a single

oh dear, RR what are you doing ... Suryavanshi aims for the road outside the ground on the leg side, but his huge heave results in a top edge that goes high in the air towards point, where Jadeja settles under the catch
nudged off the pads behind square for a single
short and wide outside off, Suryavanshi cuts hard to deep cover
pushed off the front foot to long off for a single

Samson's holed out to Brevis on the long on boundary! Another carrom ball from Ashwin, Samson went back and aimed down the ground, it skidded on to him a bit quicker and he mis-hit it this time, Brevis caught it right on the boundary
full and straight, driven down the ground for a single
full toss on the hips, the yorker gone wrong, Samson swings it away and hits it so well that it beats the fielder on the long leg boundary even though it was placed really close to him
full outside off, in the blockhole, dug out towards long on
banged in short and Suryavanshi lets it go over his head, too high says the umpire
fuller, nearly in the blockhole, and slower too ... Samson waits and dabs it close on the off side for a single
moves across his crease and works the ball off the pads through square leg
short of a length and slower, dabbed off the back foot towards point
too full on the pads, too easy for Samson who simply clips it off his toes to the long leg boundary
defended from the crease on the off side

another half-century for Suryavanshi, and he gets there by smashing the long hop into the stands at deep square leg, he's played a different innings today, not slogging at every other ball, choosing his moments well
gets an inside edge on to the pad as he jams down at one angling back into him, that was the googly ... uh oh, the siren goes off for a no-ball, Noor has over-stepped
slices the flat ball angling across him in the air over point
Samson tries to play a reverse sweep, don't see that shot often from him, but does not make contact
nudged off the pads down to long on for a single
stays in his crease and punches a flat ball angling into him towards wide long on
driven towards deep cover for a single to keep strike
fuller length outside off this time, Suryavanshi is so quick with his hands, gets under it in a flash and smashes it clean over the wide long-on boundary
played off the back foot on the off side
short ball outside off, with width to free his arms, Suryavanshi rocks back and slams the ball powerfully over the straight boundary
Samson backs away towards the leg side to create space to loft the ball inside out towards the cover boundary
width outside off from over the wicket, Suryavanshi cuts hard to deep backward point
pushed down the ground off the front foot for a single to finish the over
flicked off the pads through square leg
defended back towards the bowler this time
punched down the ground for a single to long off
played to deep midwicket for a single

Samson gets down on one knee to a full ball from Ashwin, it's the carrom ball pitched outside leg stump, and he slog sweeps so hard that he loses balance, hitting it high into the stands at deep square leg
full ball with width outside off, Samson reaches for it and hits it along the ground in front of point
short of a length, stays in his crease and opens the face to steer the ball to point
driven into the covers, Pathirana is keeping it full and straight
length ball on middle and off, Suryavanshi plays it towards mid on for a single
nearly in the blockhole on a wicket to wicket line, Suryavanshi stays in his crease and plays it to mid off
short of a length outside off, Samson stays back and opens the face late to run the ball fine towards deep third, Noor slides to his right on the boundary to save the four
Kamboj has no chance this time on the cover boundary, Suryavasnhi has blasted that with tremendous power off the front foot, beating the fielder comfortably

fuller and flatter outside off, driven firmly off the front foot to deep cover where Kamboj runs to his left and dives, he stops the ball but pushes it too far away from him and watches it trickle on to the boundary
long hop, fetch that from the stands at square leg, Suryavanshi sends it there with a powerful pull off the back foot for the first six of his innings
punched off the back foot down the ground
slogged down to long on with the angle into the left-hander from over the wicket, did not time that well
Noor slides his first ball across the right-hander from over the wicket, Samson uses the width to cut behind point
played off the pads towards the fielder at short fine
pushed into the covers
pulled towards long on for a single

that's high, very high, and just far enough to clear Brevis on the straight boundary. Samson cleared his front foot and lofted the ball straight back over the bowler's head, it didn't look like he timed it all that well at first
around the wicket to the left-hander, driven from the crease to long off for one more
stays back to one outside off and punches to long off
shot! Moves forward and towards the off to drive a length ball on the up through the covers
driven to extra cover where a sharp save keeps it to just a single
played off the pads towards midwicket
full toss angling across the left-hander, Suryavanshi drives but can't beat the diving Brevis at cover
good length again on off stump, this time Samson opens the face and steers through point to bring up the fifty for RR ... by the way, Kamboj has a really long run up
good length on a tight line around off stump, Test match stuff in a T20 game, Samson stays in his crease and punches to mid on
slower ball with width outside off, Samson mis-times the cut off the back foot in front of point
short of a length outside off, cut off the back foot to point
that's a lovely shot from Samson, just pressed forward and played a lofted checked-drive to a full ball, timing it so well that the ball bounced just inside the straight boundary
full ball on middle, played off the pads towards midwicket

superb ball but it goes for four off the outside edge! Khaleel angled it into the left-hander from over the wicket, pitched on a good length and seamed it away, Suryavanshi went poking at it and got a thick outside edge past Dhoni
length ball on the pads, Samson clips it in the air towards deep backward square leg
stays in his crease and works the ball with the angle into him through midwicket
played watchfully from his crease towards point

hits off stump and Kamboj is pumped! Hard length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Jasiwal swipes across the line and gets a thin inside edge that drags the ball back on to off stump
lofted in the air and just over the head of Ashwin on the edge of the circle at mid off, Jaiswal did not time it all that well, but it was well enough in the end
full and straight, Suryavanshi stays in his crease, moves towards the off a touch, and digs it out past the bowler
good length angling across the left-hander from over the wicket, Jaiswal moves forward and drives wide of mid-off
nearly in the blockhole to finish, dug out towards mid on for a quick single to end an expensive over
more punishment for Khaleel, short and wide, flayed off the back foot to the backward point boundary
this time it goes all the way over cover! Similar ball, length with width outside off, Jaiswal attacks again, lofting with power and hitting it farther than the previous one
over cover this time, length ball from Khaleel and Jaiswal plants his foot forward and lofts over the in field for another boundary
this time he makes superb contact with the cut shot, using the width on offer outside off to free his arms and beat the fielder on the backward point boundary
short of a length just outside off, cramping Jaiswal for room as he bottom edges the cut towards short third
gets behind the line of a good length ball and defends on the off side
driven on the up behind point for a single
up and cover the cover-point boundary! Kamboj gave him too much width this time and the length was full enough for Jaiswal to get under and free his arms while driving powerfully
backs away outside leg stump, Kamboj follows him with a full ball that swings back into the left-hander and hits Jaiswal's pads as he attempts to flick awkwardly
Jaiswal presses forward to drive again and then checks his shot and plays towards mid off, Kamboj is keeping it on a good length so far
angles the ball across the left-hander and beats the outside edge of Jaiswal's front-foot drive with a good length ball that shapes away
good length angling into the left-hander from around the wicket, Suryavanshi tries to pull but gets hit on the thigh
played to mid on for a single
slants this one into the pads and hits them as Jaiswal misses the flick
Khaleel angles the ball into the left-hander from over the wicket and gets it to seam away off the pitch, beating the inside edge of Jaiswal's front foot drive
a full ball swinging into the pads, Jaiswal gets an inside edge on to the pad

starts with a wayward delivery down leg side, too far away from Dhoni's reach even with the dive, Jaiswal tried to hammer it too ... oh he got a bit of glove on it as he swung across the line, should go down as a chance
